answer: Give each earning identity a random-time service test drawn from live jobs, such as routing a saffron cargo past a beacon in a narrow inlet. Responses must meet a short deadline; a missed or copied result forfeits that identity's escrow and earning slot. Tests can arrive simultaneously, so a Sybil operator running 1,000 aliases must fund 1,000 deposits and enough live compute to solve 1,000 different jobs at once.
